title: Security: plaintext secret detected in envelope field
description: An envelope field contains a plaintext secret (e.g. a credential string). Worker registration is accepted by the transport layer, but envelope validation must reject the envelope. The security violation is caught at the envelope validation layer, not at registration.
notes: Registration succeeds (transport-layer concern). Envelope validation must fail due to the plaintext secret. No job may be dispatched on an invalid envelope.
